subject: Did the estimate arrive? Quick 15-30m walkthrough if helpful
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Caroline Wu <caroline.wu@novaproc.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up + estimate and deck from today's call

Hi Caroline —

Thanks again for the conversation this morning. Quick recap so we have alignment:
- Primary goal: reduce inference unit costs for NovaProc's real-time chat feature while keeping p99 latency under 150ms for short sessions (<= 256 tokens).
- Current traffic profile: bursty peaks at 400 rps for inference across US-East; majority of sequences < 200 tokens.
- Constraints: must run in customer VPC for PII-handling pipelines; SOC2 + encryption-at-rest required.

Attached are the 1) tailored estimate and 2) a short deck that shows the Dedicated and Private deployment options we talked about. High-level notes inside the estimate about autoscaling policy and recommended quantization profile for your workload.

Can you confirm the packet arrived on your side? If it would be useful I can walk through the estimate with you and your infra owner — I have 15–30 minute slots open this week.

Next steps I propose:
- You confirm receipt
- We schedule a 20–30m walkthrough with your infra/ops (if helpful) to clarify the autoscale/burst assumptions and removable line items

Attachments: Redwood_Estimate_NovaProc_v1.pdf (estimate), redwood_capacity_and_pricing_deck.pdf (3-slide summary)

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0198
